qa_pair.question: Among the atoms in the Layout category, which one lists the fewest props in its manifest entry? Answer with the component name only.
How many molecules in the Inputs category forward their ref to an HTMLInputElement? Answer with a number only.
In the purple dark theme, which primitive colour token does the semantic token --dbm-bg-brand alias? Answer with the token name only, including the leading dashes.
How many design tokens, of every layer, does the Avatar component's own stylesheet use? Answer with a number only.
A small wrapper component lets every tooltip below it share one hover delay. The component it supports belongs to which tier (atom, molecule, organism or template)? Answer with the tier only.
Which component is built from the most parts (the pieces of a compound component, such as Navbar.Link)? Answer with the component name only.
According to the guide that ships for AI agents, what is the name of the prop that marks a field's invalid state? Answer with the prop name only.
Which exported hook keeps a closed announcement closed the next time the visitor comes back? Answer with the hook name only.
Which component lets a person choose a start and an end within a single day, as opposed to one moment? Answer with the component name only.
Of the parts of the Navbar, which one other than the menu button forwards its ref to an HTMLButtonElement? Answer with the full part name only, such as Navbar.Link.
